snippet.title: Odd Rock Out - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5347410/Odd_Rock_Out/
-
A cozy first-person search game about finding your house key inside one of thousands of pebbles. Pick them up, shake them by your ear, and listen for the one that rattles.
